# Run away digital QA

On 2026-10-19, the generated site was checked in headless Chrome at 1440×900 and 390×844. The Chapter 21 leaf, chapter map, homepage Chapter 21 stop and standalone reader loaded the doorway art without horizontal overflow. The selected manuscript rendered 174 paragraphs and three section breaks in the built reader; the chapter map reported full text and the chapter icon used the doorway key. The desktop cover and reading panel both measured 833 px high. Source/build checks passed with 33 editorial chapters, 17 exact manuscripts and all local links; nine unit tests passed.

Visual evidence: [aligned portal](../../../docs/qa/runaway-board-portal-composition.png), [desktop chapter](../../../docs/qa/runaway-chapter-desktop.png), [mobile chapter](../../../docs/qa/runaway-chapter-mobile.png), [desktop chapter map](../../../docs/qa/runaway-map-desktop.png), [desktop cover stop](../../../docs/qa/runaway-cover-desktop.png), [mobile standalone reader](../../../docs/qa/runaway-standalone-mobile.png).

These are local digital rendering checks. The flattened board needs separated original artwork and printer specifications before any print file can be certified.
